restaurant_name: Smiles R Us (คลีนิคทำฟัน)
text: The clinic is terrible, especially the service. This has happened multiple times. I've been to get my monthly braces changed, and sometimes they schedule appointments for early in the morning, even when I arrive early, making me wait for hours. My boyfriend and I were complaining about the early appointments. Then, when I was just a few minutes late, the doctor yelled at me like I was the one at fault. Most recently, today, the staff member who schedules my appointment said 9:45, but it looked like they wrote 8:45 on the slip. The doctor said I was late and had to wait another hour. I had other things to do and was in a hurry, and I didn't want to waste my time because of the staff's carelessness. I don't mind mistakes happen, but this has happened so many times. It's like if a patient makes a mistake, even a slight lateness, I have to wait. Even though I had other things to do, since the doctor made the mistake in scheduling, all I could do was wait. I even want to change clinics, but I've already paid 50,000 baht, almost 100,000 baht in total. I think the service should be much better. The orthodontist's work is excellent; my teeth are straightening very well. However, the staff's service is the worst. If I could complain, I would have countless times. They are generally polite and provide good service. But the issue is time management. Sometimes, even when they call to communicate, they cause misunderstandings, to the point where the doctor has to call to explain themselves.
